paragraphs: An open Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters has sickened 27 people across 12 states, with 5 hospitalizations reported [1]. The outbreak involves Salmonella Telelkebir [1].

A Class I recall has been issued for Imperio Fuego Beef Jerky products sold in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, and Wisconsin [2]. The 2 oz. sealed bags were produced without the benefit of inspection [2]. Consumers who have this product should not eat it [10].

Additional recalls this week include Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2-Pound Mung Beans due to potential glass contamination [3], and WinCo Foods Brand Hoagie Rolls due to undeclared sesame allergen [4]. The mung beans were recalled by Vitamin Cottage Natural Food Markets, Inc. [3], and the hoagie rolls were recalled by WinCo Foods of Boise, Idaho [4]. Wild West Seed Inc. is also recalling almost 10,000 pounds of broccoli sprouting seeds contaminated with Salmonella [13].
